name: GEM Services, Inc.
summary: GEM Services, Inc. functions as a specialized contractor within the semiconductor sector, delivering comprehensive manufacturing solutions for power management semiconductors through its assembly and testing expertise. The company's service offerings span various assembly processes, such as initial wafer probing, component assembly, and final product testing. They also engage in developing innovative packaging solutions and conduct thorough electrical validation, including wafer probing, electrical checks, data logging, and performance characterization. Additionally, GEM Services provides crucial reliability assurance through dedicated testing capabilities and detailed failure analysis. To further support its clients, the company manages logistics services, facilitating both direct shipments to end-users and drop-shipment options. Established in 1998, GEM Services, Inc. is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, and operates as a subsidiary of Elite Advanced Laser Corporation.
